functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_user_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.users
  SET 
    email = NEW.email,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = NEW.id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: sync_user_update
update_updated_at_column

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.users (
    id,
    email,
    role,
    full_name,
    onboarding_complete,
    is_active,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email,
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'role', 'student'),
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', NEW.email),
    FALSE,
    TRUE,
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: handle_new_user
rls_auto_enable

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_tutor(user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM tutor_profiles
    WHERE user_id = user_id::UUID
    AND is_verified = true
  );
END;
$function$
functions.name: is_tutor
protect_privileged_columns

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin(user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.users
    WHERE id = user_id
      AND is_super_admin = true
  );
$function$
functions.name: is_admin

statements:
create table if not exists public.tech_guard_services (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name text not null,
  slug text unique not null,
  description text not null,
  featured boolean not null default true,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists public.tech_guard_projects (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name text not null,
  category text not null,
  description text not null,
  url text,
  featured boolean not null default true,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists public.tech_guard_leads (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name text not null,
  email text not null,
  phone text,
  company text,
  service text,
  message text not null,
  status text not null default 'new' check (status in ('new','contacted','closed')),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

alter table public.tech_guard_services enable row level security;
alter table public.tech_guard_projects enable row level security;
alter table public.tech_guard_leads enable row level security;

create policy "public can read services" on public.tech_guard_services for select to anon, authenticated using (true);
create policy "public can read projects" on public.tech_guard_projects for select to anon, authenticated using (true);
create policy "public can submit leads" on public.tech_guard_leads for insert to anon, authenticated with check (true);
